items.exampleEn: The company refused to back down on the price.
items.exampleZh: 那家公司在價格上拒絕讓步。

items.exampleEn: I need to brush up on my French before the trip.
items.exampleZh: 出發前我得溫習一下法文。

items.exampleEn: I looked the menu over while I waited for my friend.
items.exampleZh: 等朋友的時候，我瀏覽了一下菜單。

items.exampleEn: He bought her flowers to make up for being late.
items.exampleZh: 他買花給她，想彌補自己遲到這件事。

items.exampleEn: The website lets you narrow your search down by price.
items.exampleZh: 這個網站可以讓你依價格縮小搜尋範圍。

items.exampleEn: My grandfather passed his stories on to me.
items.exampleZh: 爺爺把他的故事傳給了我。

items.exampleEn: She finally paid her car loan off.

items.sentenceEn: All her hard work finally paid off.
items.sentenceZh: 她所有的努力終於有了回報。

items.audioEn: Can you look over my slides before the meeting? I want to make sure there are no mistakes.
items.audioZh: 你可以在開會前幫我檢查一下投影片嗎？我想確定沒有錯誤。

items.sentenceEn: Many workers brush up on their English before a job interview.
items.sentenceZh: 很多上班族在求職面試前會溫習英文。

items.sentenceEn: Nothing can make up for lost time.
items.sentenceZh: 失去的時間是什麼都彌補不了的。

items.stemEn: I worked on Saturday to ____ the day I missed last week.
items.stemZh: 我星期六去上班，彌補上週請假的那一天。

items.stemEn: When you hear the results, please ____ the news to the rest of the team.
items.stemZh: 你聽到結果時，請把消息轉達給團隊其他人。

items.passageEn: Leo had been out of school for a year, so before applying for jobs, he spent a month brushing up on his computer skills. His older sister looked over his letter and fixed a few small mistakes. His first interview did not go well, because he was too nervous to answer clearly. Still, he practiced every evening with his sister, and two weeks later, a travel company offered him a job in its main office. Leo says the hardest part was believing in himself.
items.passageZh: Leo 離開學校已經一年了，所以在找工作之前，他花了一個月溫習電腦技能。他姊姊檢查了他的求職信，改了幾個小錯誤。他第一次面試不太順利，因為他太緊張，沒辦法把話說清楚。不過他每天晚上都和姊姊練習，兩週後，一家旅行社錄取他到總公司上班。Leo 說，最難的部分是相信自己。

questions.questionZh: Leo 的姊姊幫了他什麼忙？
options: 介紹他到旅行社的總公司上班
檢查他的信並改正錯誤

questions.questionZh: 第一次面試為什麼不順利？

items.promptZh: 經過一個小時的討論，經理終於讓步了。
referenceEn: After an hour of discussion, the manager finally backed down.
The manager finally backed down after discussing it for an hour.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「讓步」（例如 finally backed down 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 gave in、gave way、compromised 等）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 backed down、has backed down 等）
「經過一個小時的討論」可寫，例如 after an hour of discussion 等

items.promptZh: 我們把旅行的地點縮小到兩個城市。
referenceEn: We narrowed down our destinations to two cities.
We narrowed our choices down to two cities for the trip.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「縮小範圍」（例如 narrowed down our choices 等）；受詞可放在 down 的前面或後面
不用片語但意思正確也算對（例如 limited our choices to two cities、cut our list to two cities 等）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 narrowed、have narrowed 等）
「旅行的地點」可寫，例如 our destinations、our choices for the trip 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 審題員 issue 結案：「We narrowed down our travel plans to two cities」語意偏移：promptZh 是把「旅行的地點」縮小到兩個城市，縮小的是候選地點而非 travel plans，搭配不自然；建議改 We narrowed down our destinations to two cities；rubricZh 第 3 點舉例 our travel plans 也宜一併改為 our destinations / the places to visit。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：參考答案改為 "We narrowed down our destinations to two cities."；評分要點第 3 點的例子同步改為 our destinations、our choices for the trip 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 審題員 issue 結案：「他買花給她，彌補自己遲到。」中文不完整、不通順（彌補的是遲到這件事的過失），建議「他買花給她，彌補自己遲到的過錯。」或「…當作遲到的補償。」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：中譯改為「他買花給她，想彌補自己遲到這件事。」
